scientific_integrity: The orbit theorem is proved by quadratic geometry and central automorphism lifts. Small finite computations are independent corroboration, not proof of universal statements; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to extraspecial 2-groups of either Arf type and their full automorphism groups.
Counts of totally singular subspaces and orthogonal automorphism quotients are classical ingredients.
Historical priority of explicit tuple-orbit formulation cannot be established exhaustively.
title: Automorphism-orbit thresholds for commuting involutions in extraspecial \(2\)-groups
